import datetime
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

# --- 1. Create the cover page PDF with reportlab ---
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

cover_path = "cover_page.pdf"
width, height = letter

now = datetime.date.today()
date_str = now.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

c = canvas.Canvas(cover_path, pagesize=letter)

# Title centered on the page
c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0 + 1.0 * inch, "Annual Financial Report")

# Date below the title
c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0 - 0.6 * inch, date_str)

c.showPage()
c.save()
print("Created cover page:", cover_path, "with date", date_str)

# --- 2. Merge cover page with report.pdf ---
reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
print("Original report.pdf page count:", len(reader.pages))

cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_path)

writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

output_path = "report_with_cover.pdf"
with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
print("Wrote:", output_path)

# --- 3. Verify ---
check = PdfReader(output_path)
print("Final page count:", len(check.pages))

import shutil

tools = [
    "qpdf", "pdftk", "pdftotext", "pdfinfo", "pdftoppm",
    "gs", "convert", "magick", "img2pdf", "mutool", "python3",
]
for t in tools:
    path = shutil.which(t)
    print(f"{t:12} -> {path if path else 'NOT FOUND'}")

import re

data = open("report.pdf", "rb").read()
print("File size:", len(data))

# Show the header
print("\n--- First 120 bytes ---")
print(data[:120])

# Find object definitions
print("\n--- Objects ---")
for m in re.finditer(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+obj\b", data):
    num, gen = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
    start = m.start()
    # find endobj
    endm = re.search(rb"endobj", data[start:])
    end = start + endm.start() + 6 if endm else len(data)
    chunk = data[start:end]
    head = chunk[:250]
    # Detect streams
    has_stream = b"/FlateDecode" in chunk or b"/FlateDecode" in head
    print(f"\n--- obj {num} {gen} at offset {start} ({end - start} bytes) ---")
    print(head)

import datetime
import re
import zlib

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- parsing ---
data = open("report.pdf", "rb").read()


def parse_objects(raw):
    objs = []
    for m in re.finditer(rb"(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+obj\b", raw):
        num, gen = int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))
        start = m.start()
        rest = raw[start:]
        es = rest.find(b"endstream")
        if es != -1:
            eo = rest.find(b"endobj", es + len(b"endstream"))
        else:
            eo = rest.find(b"endobj")
        end = start + eo + len(b"endobj")
        objs.append((num, gen, raw[start:end]))
    return objs


objs = parse_objects(data)
by_num = {n: (g, b) for n, g, b in objs}
print("Parsed objects:", sorted(by_num.keys()))

# Object 8 = the only content stream, filters [ASCII85Decode FlateDecode]
_, _, obj8 = by_num[8]
stream_m = re.search(rb"stream\r?\n", obj8)
stream_start = stream_m.end()
stream_end = obj8.find(b"endstream")
ascii85_data = obj8[stream_start:stream_end]
print("ASCII85 stream length:", len(ascii85_data), "declared /Length: 771")

# Decode ASCII85 (PDF flavour, may or may not carry <~ ... ~> markers)
flate_data = None
for kwargs in (dict(adobe=True), dict(adobe=False)):
    try:
        flate_data = base64.a85decode(ascii85_data, **kwargs)
        print("ASCII85 decode OK with", kwargs)
        break
    except Exception as e:
        print("a85 decode failed with", kwargs, "->", e)
if flate_data is None:
    # manual: strip whitespace and trailing ~>
    cleaned = re.sub(rb"\s", b"", ascii85_data)
    if cleaned.endswith(b"~>"):
        cleaned = cleaned[:-2]
    if len(cleaned) % 5:
        cleaned += b"u" * (5 - len(cleaned) % 5)
    flate_data = base64.a85decode(cleaned, adobe=False)
    print("ASCII85 decode OK via manual padding path")

content = zlib.decompress(flate_data)
print("Decoded report content (%d bytes), head:" % len(content))
print(content[:300])

# ------------------------------------------------------------- new objects ---
date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print("Cover date:", date_str)

F_HELV = 7
F_HELVB = 8
objs_out = {}  # num -> raw bytes

objs_out[1] = b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>"
objs_out[2] = b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [ 3 0 R 5 0 R ] /Count 2 >>"
objs_out[3] = (
    b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [ 0 0 612 792 ] "
    b"/Resources 4 0 R /Contents 6 0 R >>"
)
objs_out[4] = (
    b"<< /Font << /F1 " + str(F_HELVB).encode() + b" 0 R /F2 " + str(F_HELV).encode() +
    b" 0 R >> /ProcSet [ /PDF /Text ] >>"
)
objs_out[5] = (
    b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [ 0 0 612 792 ] "
    b"/Resources 9 0 R /Contents 10 0 R >>"
)

# Cover page content stream (uncompressed)
title = b"Annual Financial Report"
x_title = int((612 - len(title) * 0.52 * 30) / 2)
x_date = int((612 - len(date_str) * 0.52 * 18) / 2)
cover_stream = b"".join([
    b"BT\n",
    b"/F1 30 Tf\n",
    b"0.2 0.2 0.2 rg\n",
    str(x_title).encode() + b" 430 Td\n",
    b"(" + title + b") Tj\n",
    b"/F2 18 Tf\n",
    b"0 0 0 rg\n",
    str(x_date).encode() + b" 386 Td\n",
    b"(" + date_str.encode() + b") Tj\n",
    b"ET\n",
])
objs_out[6] = (
    b"<< /Length " + str(len(cover_stream)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n" +
    cover_stream + b"endstream"
)

objs_out[F_HELV] = (
    b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica "
    b"/Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>"
)
objs_out[F_HELVB] = (
    b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold "
    b"/Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>"
)

objs_out[9] = (
    b"<< /Font << /F1 " + str(F_HELV).encode() + b" 0 R /F2 " + str(F_HELVB).encode() +
    b" 0 R >> /ProcSet [ /PDF /Text ] >>"
)

# Report page content: reuse the decoded original stream
objs_out[10] = (
    b"<< /Length " + str(len(content)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n" +
    content + b"\nendstream"
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------- write out ---
out = bytearray()
out += b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n"

offsets = {0: 0}
for num in sorted(objs_out):
    offsets[num] = len(out)
    out += str(num).encode() + b" 0 obj\n" + objs_out[num] + b"\nendobj\n"

xref_pos = len(out)
count = max(offsets) + 1
out += b"xref\n0 " + str(count).encode() + b"\n"
out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
for num in range(1, count):
    out += ("%010d 00000 n \n" % offsets[num]).encode()

out += b"trailer\n<< /Size " + str(count).encode() + b" /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
out += b"startxref\n" + str(xref_pos).encode() + b"\n%%EOF\n"

with open("report_with_cover.pdf", "wb") as f:
    f.write(out)
print("Wrote report_with_cover.pdf:", len(out), "bytes")

# -------------------------------------------------------------- self-check ---
back = open("report_with_cover.pdf", "rb").read()
m = re.search(rb"startxref\n(\d+)\n%%EOF", back)
check_objs = parse_objects(back)
print("Re-parsed object count:", len(check_objs))
